_comment: Hand-labelled ground-truth boxes for the camera/*.jpg frames in this session, measured by eye from the actual photos (NOT the finder's own output, which is wrong here - that's the whole point of this session). Format matches training-photos/boxes.json: [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of the 320x320 camera square, or null for no chocolate present. Rough measurement (hand-cropped and visually checked once), not pixel-perfect - good enough to teach the finder roughly where/how big, not for precise evaluation.
